title: CUMPRINC follows PPMT on one loan and not in general; its own route is open
statement: On the 30-year loan, CUMPRINC(0.05/12,360,200000,1,12,0) equals the left-to-right binary64 sum of Excel's own twelve PPMT answers, to the last bit, and CUMIPMT over the same periods equals 12*PMT - CUMPRINC, computed from Excel's own answers, to the last bit. That does not generalise: over recorded type 0 calls for a single period, CUMPRINC equals PPMT on 56 of 135 rows and differs on 79, with PPMT computed by the route in FN-IPMT-001.
basis: One loan block of the catalogue capture, recomputed from the recorded answers by binary64 arithmetic, and 135 recorded single-period CUMPRINC rows compared with PPMT's route.
inferred: That the 79 single-period differences are CUMPRINC's own and not PPMT's rests on the PPMT route, which matches every fv 0, type 0 row tested. That CUMIPMT remains count*PMT less CUMPRINC beyond this block is inferred.
